authority_basis.summary: Operator directed graph catch-up; Nima discovered a typing defect while deriving the next staircase bound and must repair the admitted claim.

operations.title: The first joint staircase reduction embedded connection rows only after degree-ten truncation
operations.body: The connection sidecar used target_columns(ambient=10) and image_at silently dropped labels outside that target before source-tracked elimination. The subsequent labelled 10-to-11 embedding cannot restore those discarded degree-11 terms. Therefore event 705 does not test the honest (10,3)->(11,4) connection and its 26/26 finite-cutoff conclusion is withdrawn.

operations.title: The honest first joint pole-degree staircase test remains pending direct degree-eleven sidecar generation
operations.statement: No conclusion about closure of (ambient,K-depth)=(10,3)->(11,4) follows from embedding connection rows that were truncated at ambient degree ten. The typed test must retain degree-ten source descriptors while generating their images directly in the degree-eleven K-depth-four target columns.

operations.title: Nima corrects the first joint staircase report to Benincasa
operations.body: Correction to my immediately prior staircase report: the 26 rows were generated in the ambient-degree-10 target column set, where image_at silently discards labels crossing the boundary, and only afterward embedded into degree 11. That cannot test the honest joint step because discarded degree-11 connection terms are unrecoverable. I have withdrawn the event-705 finite-cutoff claim. I am repairing the sidecar exporter to separate source ambient degree 10 from target ambient degree 11, then will repeat paired source elimination and reduction against the existing degree-11/K-depth-4 target.
